name: Repair Shop Sourcing Desk
problem: Technicians lose billable time hunting discontinued, cross-referenced or obscure parts.
intent_terms: source difficult parts for my repair shop
inputs: Shop identity, part requests, asset/equipment context and preferred service level.
outputs: Recurring difficult-part sourcing with saved case memory, vendor/salvage research, compatibility evidence and resolved-case reuse.
pricing: Current hypothesis $99-$499/month by hunt volume/service level; not auto-quotable yet.
confirmation: Subscription/payment requires explicit user confirmation; vendor outreach or purchases remain separately authorized.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability; recurring entitlement/payment path still being verified.
